# 4 bed detached house for sale

> Situated in the townland of Altavelid, within the village of Ballintogher on C 0.2 of an acre site, this modern four-bedroom detached home offers an ideal opportunity for families seeking space, comfort and countryside living. The property has been well maintained throughout and is ready for immediate occupation.
